courant.interpretation: Native Co uses current pre-advance state and inherited/preceding deltaT; scaled Co multiplies raw by newly selected deltaT / old deltaT at that state. No timestamp shift or removal of startup evidence.

width.cell_unit_definition: Width / median normal-projected vertical-column centroid increment near threshold brackets; not isotropic cell size
width.interpolation: Linear between actual native cell centres, connected 10 and 90 percent brackets around strongest 50 percent compression crossing, no smoothing/extrapolation
